claims.statement: If the exact registered tip-surplus inequality holds for every represented branch of a nonempty ordinary arity-2,3,4 path-star and every integer k>=1 with 2k<=N+2, then each tip deletion A_i=G B_(r_i-1)H_i+zL^N and endpoint deletion A_0=LQ+zL^N satisfy A_v[k+1]C[k-1]<=A_v[k]C[k], with integer zero extension and C=GQ.
claims.scope: Conditional all-profile comparison on the exact registered lower-half guard. The proof needs the repaired local tip pair (B_(r_i-1),B_(r_i)); this does not assert the surplus premise universally and adds no actual-first-descent eligibility filter. In an actual-rank application, x is the least natural k (including terminal zero extension) with Delta_k P<0 for P=C+zL^(N+1); retain x+2<=p, 3p<2(N+2)+1, and 2p<=N+2, set j=p-2, and evaluate e_0=1[Delta_p A_0<0], e_i=1[Delta_p A_i<0] at that same current p, with b=e_0+sum_i r_i e_i and original tag multiplicities.
claims.reason: ULC curvature plus main-product LR and the exact surplus premise imply each shifted minor. The source's displayed tip pair and script use F_r instead of the B_(r-1) present in the deletion polynomial; exact checks establish the required replacement pair for r=2,3,4. Endpoint transfer uses its own (L,G) LR comparison and U_0-U_i coefficient dominance.

In an actual-rank application, x is the least natural k (including terminal zero extension) with Delta_k P<0 for P=C+zL^(N+1); retain x+2<=p, 3p<2(N+2)+1, and 2p<=N+2, set j=p-2, and evaluate e_0=1[Delta_p A_0<0], e_i=1[Delta_p A_i<0] at that same current p, with b=e_0+sum_i r_i e_i and original tag multiplicities.
claims.reason: The repaired individual tip comparison and linearity of M_k give the result after summing with positive original multiplicities r_i. The universal premise remains OPEN.

claims.statement: For every nonempty ordinary arity-2,3,4 path-star, with N=sum_i r_i, h=1+2a_2+4a_3+7a_4, C=(1+2z)product_i B_(r_i), E=z(1+z)^N, U_i=(1+2z)B_(r_i-1)product_{ell!=i}B_(r_ell), and M_k(E)=E[k]C[k]-E[k+1]C[k-1], every represented branch i and integer k>=1 with 2k<=N+2 satisfy (h+1)U_i[k]C[k]+(k+1)(h-k+1)M_k(E)>=0, with integer zero extension.
claims.scope: Universal exact-ratio tip-surplus premise on the full registered guard, with no actual-first-descent restriction. It remains distinct from selected payment/MASS and from either unconditional shifted-comparison claim. In an actual-rank application, x is the least natural k (including terminal zero extension) with Delta_k P<0 for P=C+zL^(N+1); retain x+2<=p, 3p<2(N+2)+1, and 2p<=N+2, set j=p-2, and evaluate e_0=1[Delta_p A_0<0], e_i=1[Delta_p A_i<0] at that same current p, with b=e_0+sum_i r_i e_i and original tag multiplicities.
claims.reason: The conditional bridge is not a proof of the premise. Boundary and interior checks are bounded arithmetic only; no universal proof or realizable guarded counterexample was established.

limitations: The universal tip-surplus predicate remains OPEN; finite checks do not establish it.
The local pair defect is repairable for the allowed arities, but the producer script itself does not check that repaired pair.
The conditional bridge does not prove actual selector behavior, selected payment, selected MASS, arbitrary-tree claims, or Erdős993.
The conditional convolution and TP2 arguments are informal and were not formalized in Lean.
